name: DealCloud
one_liner: DealCloud is a data/CRM platform with REST APIs and an MCP server.
auth_notes: API key from user profile exchanged with client_id and scopes for a bearer token via client credentials; tokens expire after 900 seconds.
access_notes: API must be enabled for a user group by a site admin or CSM. No self-serve signup or pricing seen.

buildability.rationale: Documented OAuth client-credentials API, but each customer site must enable API access per user group via its admin or CSM.

needs_human_reason: Rate limits, webhooks, sandbox and pricing not confirmed on official pages; Intapp ownership not confirmed.

identity.quote: The DealCloud MCP Server helps teams turn their DealCloud data into faster, higher-quality outcomes.

auth.quote: DealCloud uses the OAuth2 Client Credentials flow to generate a bearer token
Tokens expire after 900 seconds (15 minutes) and must be refreshed by repeating the flow.

access.quote: If you do not see the Admin section, contact your organization's admin or DealCloud Customer Success Manager (CSM) for assistance.
go to Capabilities > Site Areas, and enable "API".

mcp.quote: A compatible AI assistant connects to the DealCloud MCP Server and signs in as the user.

buildability.quote: ensure the intended user is assigned to a user group with the appropriate permissions.
